info.name: Create a new test template based on the PostData.

params.name: objectDetails
params.description: Set to true to return the created object in the response body, otherwise the response body will only return created object ID.

items.docs: To get payload for creating a new test template and to get the created test template details refer InternalLink[Test Template by ID Endpoint,operations-tag-TestTemplates,operations-TestTemplates-get_v2_testtemplates__ids_]. Pass “0” for Test Template ID to create a new test template.
